Jordan as John Kelly, a Navy SEAL senior chief; Lauren London as his pregnant wife Pam Kelly; Jodie Turner-Smith as Lt. Commander Karen Greer, his SEAL team leader; Jamie Bell as CIA officer Robert Ritter; Guy Pearce as US Secretary of Defense Thomas Clay; Brett Gelman as Russian agent Victor Rykov. After a hostage rescue in Aleppo, Syria turns into a fight with Russian soldiers, Russian assassins kill Kelly's teammates and his wife in the US; Kelly seeks revenge, is jailed, then joins a covert SEAL mission to Murmansk, Russia, where their plane is shot down into the Arctic sea and they fight through an apartment building; the conspiracy leads back to Washington)
